blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Advance release convergence by restoring audible automatic-combat causality, rebuilding Result/Pause presentation with unclipped authored hierarchy and accessible focus states, and re-anchoring the intact authored cemetery for readable traversal and complete-run release behavior.

diagnosis.root_cause: The release candidate has three independent player-facing defects: automatic Warden Lantern combat emits no audible Effects-bus report despite attack/hit events; Result and Pause presentation clips the Wandering Wisps label and relies on repetitive generic controls; and the preserved authored cemetery remains mausoleum-dominant, dark, sparse, and weak in human-scale warm/cool composition.

stop_conditions: Preserve the intact authored cemetery package and retained weapon strategy bindings; do not hide, duplicate, extract, replace, or surgically edit authored child meshes or source assets.
Keep damage, upgrade, restart, pooling, and run-state authority in existing gameplay systems; UI and audio presenters must not become gameplay truth.
Stop candidate work after these bounded implementation families are self-validated; GameLoop Runtime and Tester own MCP recapture, formal verdicts, issue closure, and phase closure.
Do not expand into unrelated backlog gaps, decorative asset-family quotas, or replacement-map selection.

strategy.rationale: Apply materially different root-cause treatments: repair the product-owned audio adapter/mixer and lifecycle routing, rebuild shell layout at the presenter/scene layer, and restore native-world spatial bindings through an explicit outer datum plus collision/navigation/spawn anchors instead of repeating camera transform tuning or replacing the preserved map.

code: Run focused Godot/static checks for the edited audio, UI, world, camera, spawn, and run-controller scripts plus the candidate's existing project checks.

Verify all Result/upgrade values are sourced from authoritative inventory/upgrade data, no placeholder CURRENT rows or hidden authored-map meshes were introduced, and no preserved weapon/source asset was modified.
Confirm candidate-relative target paths stay within the three bounded families and the native Godot project remains intact.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime/Tester should recapture the runtime audio causality probe: one automatic attack and one quick continuation/tap, Effects and Master WAV metrics, semantic source-event timeline, impact separation, release, and lifecycle reset.

Use the page/HUD probe at native and supported UI scales for Result, upgrade-choice navigation, Pause, keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus traversal, Restart/Retry, and clean reset; verify unclipped Wandering Wisps and authoritative selection receipts.

Use the movement/spatial probe at spawn, critical route, landmark/cardinal, perimeter, and ordinary movement replay states; verify larger traversable scale, external depth, central landmark visibility, grounding, collision, boundary, and no disappearance/occlusion drift.

Run required base validations host_godot_boot and native_godot_project plus release_convergence_automatic_combat_causality_contract, release_convergence_product_shell_accessibility_contract, and release_convergence_complete_run_release_contract. Tester owns formal pass/fail and closure.
visual: Recapture shipped gameplay camera at spawn, route, cardinal landmark, and perimeter states, judging dense layered cemetery composition, readable human scale, warm lantern versus cool moonlight hierarchy, clear escape lanes, stable central landmark, external depth, and absence of void/proxy-floor artifacts.

Recapture Result and Pause at target resolution and supported UI scales, judging full-viewport authored hierarchy, unclipped labels, silhouette/icon-first choices, compact truthful deltas, and visible complete focus states.

done_when: Automatic Warden Lantern onset and impact events each produce one bounded, recognizable transient on the Effects bus at runtime, with non-silent captured output and source timestamps aligned to attack phases.

A focused same-session black-box retest can trigger one automatic attack and one quick continuation/tap; white-box receipts expose event id, weapon id, source, Effects route, and release/reset stop causality.

The authoritative cooldown, target selection, hit, damage, and death/drop chain remains unchanged; generic shot VFX does not replay a complete player recording, and enemy spatial cues remain separate.
tasks.instructions: Repair the product-owned lantern audio adapter/director and directly related attack presentation so automatic attacks emit a short semantic onset/report and bounded impact cue through the Effects bus. Isolate onset, impact, miss, and concrete-hit stems in the event receipt and mixed output; prevent duplicate replay, long ringing material cues, and sustained audio after release or lifecycle reset. Preserve the retained weapon component/source and expose focused runtime/source instrumentation for Tester retest.
tasks.title: Restore lantern attack audio causality

done_when: Result weapon summaries show the complete Wandering Wisps label at native and supported scaled viewports without clipping, truncation, overlap, or tiny debug-like text.

Each weapon/upgrade choice leads with a recognizable silhouette or authored icon, then compact truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant deltas; CURRENT values never use NEW or LOCKED placeholders and unchanged/exhaustive rows are omitted.

Pause and Result pages use full-viewport authored hierarchy with distinct hover, pressed, disabled, selected, keyboard-focus, mouse-focus, and gamepad-focus states rather than repetitive generic bordered controls.

A same-session black-box retest covers Result opening, choice navigation, focus traversal, Pause, Restart/Retry, and clean reset; presenter receipts confirm selected weapon/upgrade data remains authoritative.
tasks.instructions: Rework the Result weapon-summary and Pause shell presenter/layout in the run shell scenes. Increase label capacity or wrap authored names, establish icon/silhouette-first hierarchy, and render compact before-to-after stat deltas bound to authoritative run data. Replace repetitive bordered controls with bespoke Mournlight spacing, dividers, typography, and state-driven focus treatments while preserving keyboard, mouse, and gamepad navigation plus deterministic retry/reset transitions.
tasks.title: Repair Result and Pause shell presentation

done_when: The authored cemetery remains one intact native environment package and the sole authoritative visual map; no authored child meshes are hidden, duplicated, extracted, or replaced by proxy roads, floors, facades, or backdrops.
The playable area has expand or larger traversable scale, with coherent external world or external depth beyond native streets and readable cardinal landmark framing.

The central building or landmark remains visible during ordinary movement or movement replay with aligned collision; the boundary or perimeter prevents pass-through, and no disappearance or occlusion drift occurs during traversal.

Spawn, objective, navigation, collision, and camera framing are re-anchored to native authored streets/terrain, with stable player grounding, clear escape lanes, no visible void, and no proxy-floor artifacts.
A complete-run route can reach Result and Retry cleanly after ordinary play, with spatial state reset and no stale entities or anchors.
tasks.instructions: Advance the complete-run spatial release contract by re-anchoring spawn/objective/navigation/collision and camera to native authored streets and terrain. Add only one product-owned outer datum plus gameplay boundaries and anchors as needed; remove or minimize unrelated proxy/support clutter. Ensure expand or larger traversable scale, external world or external depth, central building or landmark, collision, disappearance or occlusion, boundary or perimeter, and ordinary movement or movement replay are explicit acceptance probes, while preserving the intact map package and its warm lantern versus cool moonlight composition.
tasks.title: Re-anchor authored cemetery traversal and release
